channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Netanyahu Corruption Trial: Ex-Attorney General Testifies
item.description: Former Israeli Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit has begun testifying in the corruption trial of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Mandelblit's testimony reportedly concerns the authorization of investigations into Netanyahu. The trial… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Court hears emoji use implied consent in rape case
item.description: A court heard that the use of emojis by a complainant in a rape case implied consent. The Sydney Morning Herald reported on the proceedings where this argument was presented. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Co-Pilot's Plane Crashing Attempt Investigated
item.description: An investigation is underway into a Flydubai flight, FZ1073, involving an Omani co-pilot. Reports indicate the co-pilot was inspired by the 9/11 attacks and intended to crash the plane into an Israeli airport. The co-pilot reportedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: ICE Agent Hits Man During Chase in Texas
item.description: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent in Texas struck a man with a vehicle on Saturday during a pursuit in the Houston area. The man, identified as Parra-Hernandez, sustained a suspected broken leg and was taken to a hospital… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Delhi Police conducted a crackdown on journalists on October 10, an action that has drawn criticism. Actor Prakash Raj stated that disrespecting the media amounts to insulting citizens. The incident involved police action against… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Student Drowns in Telangana Quarry While Filming Reels
item.description: An 18-year-old BTech student drowned in a quarry in Telangana while attempting to film Instagram reels. The incident occurred during a photo outing inspired by reels. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Directs Centre on Transport, Rejects Protester Detentions
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has directed the Centre to ensure the availability of regular transport facilities and internet services amidst protests led by the CJP. The court also rejected the detention of protesters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ghaziabad Police Arrest Wife and Lover in Husband's Murder
item.description: Ghaziabad police arrested a wife and her lover within 12 hours in connection with the murder of her husband. The incident occurred in the Masuri area of Ghaziabad district, Uttar Pradesh. The wife had been living at her parental home… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Car Insurance Company Fined for Denying Theft Claim
item.description: A car insurance company has been ordered to pay approximately eight lakh rupees in compensation after wrongly rejecting a theft claim. The company's arbitrary decision to deny the claim for a stolen car in Delhi has drawn criticism. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NIA arrests suspect in terror plot targeting West Bengal and Northeast
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested Mahmudul Qafila in connection with a terror plot aimed at targeting West Bengal and the northeastern states. The plot involved spreading a terror network in these regions. Qafila is an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: NIA arrests suspected JMB member in Bengal, seizes devices
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested a suspected member of the Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB) in West Bengal. During the arrest, the NIA seized phones and memory cards. The agency had previously raided the suspect's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Release Video of Interaction with Abhijit Dipke
item.description: Delhi Police released a video of their interaction with Abhijit Dipke, claiming it shows them offering assistance following his grandmother's death. The video was issued in response to events surrounding Dipke's grandmother's passing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: 10 Alleged Drug Peddlers Arrested in Anantnag, Narcotics Seized
item.description: Anantnag police in Kashmir arrested 10 individuals alleged to be drug peddlers within a single day. Among those arrested, two are from West Bengal. Narcotics valued at "lakhs" were seized during the operation. The specific amount and type… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Saudi Airport Attacked Amid West Asia Tensions, Flights Cancelled
item.description: Multiple airports in Saudi Arabia, including in the capital and Sanaa, have been attacked amid escalating West Asia tensions. Houthi-aligned media reported strikes on Sanaa International Airport, with Houthi spokesperson warning against… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Three Killed in Kochi After Mini Cooper Rams Scooter
item.description: Three 21-year-old individuals, identified as Devika, Gopika, and Ijaz, were killed when a Mini Cooper car collided with their scooter near Kochi airport in Ernakulam district. The deceased were part-time salespersons returning to duty. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: 22 Indian sailors rescued after tanker hit by drone off UAE coast
item.description: Twenty-two Indian sailors were rescued after a drone attack set a Panama-flagged tanker ablaze off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The incident occurred at sea, and all crew members were safely brought back. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Abhijeet Dipke's Parents Criticize Government After Delhi Police Action
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke's parents have criticized the government following his detention by Delhi Police. They expressed fear that "honest youths are being put behind bars." Dipke, identified as the founder of CJP, was detained by Delhi Police. In… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 2.

item.title: Post-mortem report reveals Nana Patekar's cause of death
item.description: The post-mortem report of Nana Patekar has revealed the cause of his death. Reports indicate that a heart condition led to his demise, dispelling any suspicions of foul play or conspiracy. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: Supreme Court Petition Filed Over Metro Station Closures
item.description: A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging violation of court orders regarding the closure of metro stations. Petitioner lawyer Shailendra Mani Tripathi claims that despite directives, some station gates remain shut… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.description: Following a shooting involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in New York City, a political clash has erupted over sanctuary city policies. Representative Markwayne Mullin criticized these policies in the aftermath of… Coverage: Left 6 · Centre 8 · Right 2.

item.title: Trump Launches Inquiry into Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has established a committee to investigate Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. The inquiry is reportedly focused on allegations of mortgage fraud. This action comes despite a Supreme Court ruling that previously… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: US DOJ Probes TV Networks Over White House Pool Coverage Halt
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) is investigating whether the halt in White House television pool coverage violated antitrust laws. The probe specifically examines the response of major TV networks to a White House ban on CNN's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Police Seek Suspects in Kitchener Vehicle Theft
item.description: Waterloo Regional Police are searching for suspects involved in a vehicle theft that occurred in Kitchener. Further details regarding the incident, including the number of suspects or the specific vehicle, were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former Wuhan Mayor Sentenced to 14 Years for Bribery
item.description: A former mayor of Wuhan, the Chinese city where the coronavirus outbreak began, was sentenced to 14 years in prison on Saturday after being convicted of bribery. The conviction and sentencing were handed down by a court more than six years… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Sharjeel Imam's interim bail cancelled by Delhi court
item.description: A Delhi court has cancelled the interim bail granted to activist Sharjeel Imam. The Delhi Police had moved the court seeking cancellation, alleging that Imam had breached the conditions of his bail, specifically a media gag order. The case… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Autopsy Confirms Actor Nana Patekar Died of Heart Attack
item.description: Actor Nana Patekar died of a heart attack caused by a blood clot in a major heart artery. Doctors attempted to revive him for 45 minutes without success. An autopsy conducted at Goa Medical College confirmed the cause of death. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Pope Francis Declares Death Penalty 'Inadmissible'
item.description: Pope Francis has declared the death penalty 'inadmissible,' stating it attacks the inherent dignity of a human being. This declaration follows the U.S. administration's approval of a firing squad execution for Nidal Hasan. The Pope's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Actor Imran Khan Detained During Mumbai Protest
item.description: Actor Imran Khan was detained by Mumbai Police during a protest at August Kranti Maidan. A video of the incident has gone viral. Khan was reportedly detained for participating in a protest organized by CJP. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 12 · Right 3.

item.title: IndiGo Flight Diverted to Hyderabad After Power Bank Fire
item.description: An IndiGo flight traveling from Delhi to Chennai was diverted to Hyderabad on Sunday after a passenger's power bank caught fire mid-air, emitting smoke. The incident led to an emergency landing in Hyderabad, where the aircraft landed… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 12 · Right 4.

item.title: Fort Hood survivor objects to execution viewing method
item.description: A survivor of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting has expressed a desire to witness the execution of the mass shooter, Nidal Hasan. The survivor, who has not been named in the coverage, stated, "Look at my eyes," indicating a wish for a direct… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Socialite's Murder in Hong Kong Involves Ex-Boyfriend and Father
item.description: A murder case in Hong Kong has drawn attention to a socialite, her former boyfriend, and his father, who is accused of being the mastermind. The details of the case have emerged following the shocking incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Teenagers and dog escape house fire in South Sydney
item.description: Two teenagers and their dog escaped a house fire in South Sydney unharmed. The fire broke out in a home in the suburb of Kogarah. Firefighters responded to the incident and extinguished the blaze. No injuries were reported. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump to decide on livestreaming Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated he will decide whether to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Banks Consider Increased Cybersecurity Spending Amid AI-Linked Hacks
item.description: Banks are reportedly considering increasing their spending on cybersecurity following incidents of hacking linked to artificial intelligence. South Korea has issued a warning about AI-assisted hacking after breaches affected the cyber… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka HC stays FIRs against BJP agents over voter form objections
item.description: The Karnataka High Court has stayed First Information Reports (FIRs) filed against Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) booth agents in Malleswaram concerning objections raised using Form 7. The FIRs were related to alleged bulk voter deletion… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Three More Held in Punjabi Influencer Mad Sandhu Murder Case
item.description: Three more individuals have been apprehended in connection with the murder of Punjabi influencer Mad Sandhu. The accused, identified as Harsimranjit Singh alias Simu Singga, Fateh Singh, and Arman Singh, were detained on October 10 in Vapi… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: TV Actor Rescued from Alleged Prostitution Racket in Thane
item.description: A television actor was rescued from an alleged prostitution racket in Thane. Police arrested a 39-year-old woman in connection with the case. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tanker Explodes After Hitting Mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: An Iranian supertanker struck naval mines and caught fire while attempting to exit the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran's IRGC. The tanker reportedly exploded after hitting the mines. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK man jailed for ₹2.54 crore crypto SIM-swap fraud
item.description: A 25-year-old man from the UK has been sentenced to two-and-a-half years in prison for a SIM-swap fraud that resulted in a ₹2.54 crore cryptocurrency heist. He pleaded guilty to the charges. The stolen funds were allegedly spent on luxury… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala High Court orders functional Data Protection Board in 8 weeks
item.description: The Kerala High Court has directed the Centre to make the Data Protection Board functional within eight weeks. This order comes in response to a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) that raised concerns about the compromise of citizens'… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
